mapper.select: SELECT * FROM assessment_task WHERE id=#{assessmentId} AND created_by=#{ownerId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM training WHERE id=#{trainingId} AND created_by=#{ownerId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training(name,description,survey_enabled,questions_json,created_by,assessment_id,category,requirement_type,purpose,start_at,end_at) SELECT #{name},description,survey_enabled,questions_json,created_by,NULL,category,requirement_type,'STANDALONE',start_at,end_at FROM training WHERE id=#{sourceTrainingId}
mapper.update: UPDATE training SET audience_type='USERS' WHERE id=#{trainingId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM training_video WHERE training_id=#{trainingId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT * FROM training_material WHERE training_id=#{trainingId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO training_material_page(material_id,page_number,required_seconds) SELECT #{materialId},page_number,required_seconds FROM training_material_page WHERE material_id=#{sourceMaterialId}
